eras.title: The city in its mounds
eras.caption: Uruk's broad ruins preserve temple platforms and layers of buildings from one of Mesopotamia's earliest great cities. Beneath the worn earthen surfaces, excavation has recovered evidence of administration, craftwork and early writing.
